evidence: Homepage shows "共 8 个非遗项目" with 8 cards, each with title, category tag, region, and description (春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂).
Clicking "了解详情" link for 春节 navigated to dedicated page at /heritage/spring-festival.

/heritage/spring-festival page shows title 春节, English name "Spring Festival", region "北京 · 华夏大地", induction year "2006年入选", full description paragraph, and an image gallery (main image + 3 thumbnails).
Selecting category filter "传统工艺" reduced list from "共 8 个非遗项目" to "共 2 个非遗项目" (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂), confirming category-based browsing across 传统工艺/传统表演/民俗活动/传统美术.

Sort-by-region reordered list correctly (安徽,北京,北京,广东,江苏x3,陕西). Panorama drag rotated scene (rotateX 0→3.6deg) and zoom-in button changed scale 1→1.2 while rotation persisted. After opening 苏绣 hotspot overlay and navigating to its detail page then clicking "返回全景探索", panorama restored exact prior transform (scale 1.2, rotateX 3.6deg) AND reopened the same 苏绣 hotspot overlay automatically.

On panorama load, transient text "正在加载热点... (7/8)" appeared showing hotspot loading progress. On /heritage/spring-festival detail page, the primary image failed to load and displayed fallback text "图片加载失败" with an icon.
All 8 items each display exactly one category tag on their card/hotspot: 民俗活动 (春节, 端午龙舟), 传统美术 (剪纸, 书法), 传统表演 (京剧, 昆曲), 传统工艺 (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂).

Navigating to an invalid slug /heritage/nonexistent-item shows "未找到该非遗项目" with a "返回首页" link instead of a details page, while valid slugs (spring-festival, suzhou-embroidery) correctly open their detail pages.
Every list card includes title, region, and description text; every detail page (e.g., spring-festival) includes title, region, and description.

List view uses a card grid with search/filter/sort controls, while detail view uses a breadcrumb nav, large image gallery with thumbnails, and single-item layout with "返回全景探索"/"浏览更多项目" actions — structurally and visually distinct states.

All 8 exhibited items (Spring Festival, Dragon Boat Racing, Paper Cutting, Peking Opera, Kunqu Opera, Chinese Calligraphy, Suzhou Embroidery, Yixing Purple Clay) are genuine, well-known Chinese ICH items with accurate regional attributions (Beijing, Guangdong, Shaanxi, Jiangsu, Anhui) and plausible national/UNESCO induction years (e.g., "2006年入选").
